scope: Track A (retrieval only) on six fresh worlds; Tracks B and C are not part of this registration
claim_rule: CONFIRMED only when the lower bound of the 95% family-clustered interval of the paired difference (R7a minus the reference, intention to treat) is above the minimum effect
multiplicity: Holm over the secondary pairings; the primary pairing is not adjusted
wording_variants: scored beside the originals on the same questions; reported as the change in CompleteSet@10, no claim
withdrawn_questions: none; a question found defective after the seal stays in and is listed
labels: delegated and unaudited by a human (OQ13 accepted in writing by the owner, 2026-10-28)
after_the_seal: any change to code, configuration, this file or a world makes later results exploratory
